blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 4,165 of 4,447, or 93.6 percent of examinees passed the October 2026 Physicians Licensure Examination, the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced. The University of Santo Tomas (UST) topped the list of performing schools with a 100 percent passing rate for its 312 examinees. Four other schools also posted perfect passing rates: the University of the Philippines Manila, with 174 passers; the University of the East Ramon Magsaysay Memorial Medical Center, with 161; the Ateneo School of Medicine and Public Health, with 136; and West Visayas State University in La Paz, with 100.
